name: Late Night Low Volume
author: Flubsound (Flubes & Claude)
description: For listening quietly without losing the music. Auto Level and a strong two-way compressor (quiet passages up, loud ones down) hold tracks and sources at about -24 LUFS, the same night level as Night Mode Gaming, from loud masters down to quiet -40 LUFS sources. Because it levels, it plays louder than the other presets on a very quiet source and well under them on a normal stream. A fixed low-volume contour (a +3 dB bass shelf with headroom protection and a +1.5 dB shelf above 10 kHz; on mastered music about +1 dB at 31 Hz) offsets part of the ear's reduced sensitivity at low volume. The contour does not follow your volume setting.
